eligibility.reason: E1/E4: the reproduced material-lookup error and the corrective diff establish a concrete mismatch. E2: MoveIt's MeshShape derives from the separately provided rviz_rendering Shape and consumes its material name; the latter creates the material in rviz_rendering, while the former looks it up in General through Ogre. The consumer's group assumption crosses this library/plugin boundary. This is not an internal arithmetic or self-contained rendering defect, nor merely deployment wiring. E3: PAIR.

Both changed lookup calls are manifestations of this single condition.
